summary: Established 2006 with two approved areas, North Industrial and Downtown & South Industrial. The North Industrial area was amended in 2025 to include additional parts of the Jackson East Area, planned for industrial development in 2020.

source.citation: City of Hillsboro enterprise zone pages

notes: The 2025 North Industrial boundary amendment predates the 2026 application flurry and is a separate instrument from the approvals themselves. Jackson East is also the sub-area carrying two of the acreage sub-caps in Draft Order No. 8502, one of which is at its ceiling.
confidence_note: The boundary amendment instrument has not been read. Its effective date and the acreage added are NOT_CHECKED, and no relationship between the boundary amendment and the acreage caps is asserted here.
